title: melia azedarach var. cochinchinensis
intro: Melia azedarach var. cochinchinensis, commonly known as the Persian berry or Chinese parasol tree, is a variant of the Melia azedarach tree species. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its multiple health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral properties, which may aid in treating various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin diseases. The therapeutic actions of Melia azedarach var. cochinchinensis include analgesic, anti-pyretic, and anti-bacterial effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, such as azedarachin and meliatoxin, contribute to its medicinal properties and are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
